title: 第11章 林浩的心思第12章 林浩对战柳林
lines: 随着众人的议论，裁判宣布比赛开始，
左司在裁判宣布比赛开始时便直接出手，想要抢占一丝先机。
只见左司手中拂尘朝着萧逸一抖，拂尘上的白须顿时间无限延长起来，
想要将萧逸束缚住。
可是，萧逸又岂会让左司如愿，在左司动手的同时，
萧逸便脚踩《清风步》，朝着一旁躲闪而去，
并且手中长剑向前一刺，一道剑气便从长剑之上朝着左司激射而去。
转瞬之间便来到了左司的面前，不得不说，左司也确实是厉害，
面对萧逸的这道突如其来的剑气丝毫不慌，
只见他在剑气即将接触到自己的时候，一个侧身躲开了这道凌厉的剑气。
虽然如此，但左司的一缕头发也被这道剑气斩落。
而萧逸见到左司竟然躲过了他的攻击，心中更是愤怒，
因为在萧家之中还没有谁能够在他手下躲过这一招的人。
因此，萧逸眼中闪过一丝寒光，再次朝着左司攻击而去，
因为左司刚刚躲过那道剑气，还没有稳住身形，
面对萧逸的再次攻击，眼中浮现出一缕惊慌之色。
连忙抬起手中拂尘朝着萧逸的利剑抵挡而去。
可是，萧逸手中的长剑可是萧青山专门为其准备的，
又岂是左司手中那低级法器可以以抵挡，
在左司手中拂尘与萧逸的长剑接触的瞬间，
拂尘便被长剑搅碎，而萧逸手中长剑去势不减，
直接刺进了左司的手臂之中。
左司顿时发出一声惨叫向后退去，
可是，萧逸又岂会就此放过左司，他可是炎城之中的顶级天才，
没有人可以挑战他的地位，更别说这左司修为比他低，竟然还敢上台继续比赛！
这无疑是在挑衅于他！
若是不给左司一点教训，那么今后岂不是谁都敢在他面前叫嚣了！
于是，萧逸眼中闪过一丝杀意，手中长剑瞬间改变方向朝着左司的脖颈之上刺去。
左司见此，心中大骇，连忙高呼一声：
“我……我认输！”
可是，萧逸却在左司高呼认输之后剑势依旧不变朝着左司刺去。
裁判见此连忙一个闪身来到左司身前，长袖一挥，将萧逸的攻击散去！
萧逸见此冷哼一声：
这次你运气好，不过下次嘛！
哼哼……”
裁判见此心中摇了摇头，显然对萧逸小小年纪就如此狠辣感到不满！
“这一场萧家萧逸胜！”
content_en:
As everyone was talking, the referee announced the start of the game.
Zuo Si immediately took action when the referee announced the start of the game, trying to seize an opportunity.
I saw Zuo Si shaking the whisk in his hand towards Xiao Yi, and the white whiskers on the whisk suddenly extended indefinitely.
Wanting to restrain Xiao Yi.
However, how could Xiao Yi let Zuo Si get his wish? When Zuo Si took action,
Xiao Yi stepped on the "Qingfeng Step" and dodged to the side.
And he stabbed forward with the long sword in his hand, and a sword energy shot out from the long sword towards Zuo Si.
In an instant, he arrived in front of Zuo Si. I have to say that Zuo Si is indeed powerful.
Facing Xiao Yi's sudden sword energy, he didn't panic at all.
Just when the sword energy was about to touch him, he turned sideways to avoid the sharp sword energy.
Even so, a strand of Zuo Si's hair was also cut off by this sword energy.
When Xiao Yi saw that Zuo Si had escaped his attack, he felt even more angry.
Because there is no one in the Xiao family who can escape this move from him.
Therefore, a cold light flashed in Xiao Yi's eyes, and he attacked Zuo Si again,
Because Zuo Si had just dodged the sword energy and had not yet stabilized his body,
Facing Xiao Yi's attack again, a look of panic appeared in his eyes.
He quickly raised the whisk in his hand and moved towards Xiao Yi's sharp sword to block it.
However, the long sword in Xiao Yi's hand was specially prepared for him by Xiao Qingshan.
How could the low-level magic weapon in Zuo Si's hand be able to resist it?
The moment the whisk in Zuo Si's hand came into contact with Xiao Yi's sword,
The fly whisk was smashed into pieces by the long sword, but the force of the long sword in Xiao Yi's hand remained unabated.
It stabbed directly into Zuo Si's arm.
Zuo Si immediately let out a scream and stepped back.
However, how could Xiao Yi let Zuo Si go? He was the top genius in Yan City.
No one can challenge his status, let alone Zuo Si, who is lower in cultivation than him, dares to go on stage and continue the competition!
This is undoubtedly provoking him!
If Zuo Si is not taught a lesson, then no one will dare to scream in front of him in the future!
Then, a trace of killing intent flashed in Xiao Yi's eyes, and the long sword in his hand instantly changed direction and stabbed Zuo Si's neck.
When Zuo Si saw this, he was horrified and shouted quickly:
"I...I give up!"
However, Xiao Yi stabbed Zuo Si with his sword without changing even after Zuo Si shouted to admit defeat.
Seeing this, the referee quickly ducked in front of Zuo Si, waved his long sleeves, and dispersed Xiao Yi's attack!
Xiao Yi snorted coldly when he saw this:
"Hmph!
You're lucky this time, but next time!
Hum hum…”
The referee shook his head when he saw this, obviously dissatisfied with Xiao Yi being so cruel at such a young age!
"This is Xiao Yisheng of the Xiao family!"
